notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim ol pronom, Hibru i stap wantaim אשר we no gat pronom.

notes.subject: יד ושם
notes.rationale: Tupela ridin: 'han na nem' (literol) o wanpela tok 'yad wa-shem' — mak bilong monimen, semak olsem 'moniment na memorial'.

notes.subject: katim i go ausait
notes.rationale: כרת i min 'katim', Tok Pisin i tok 'katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en' bilong tok olsem Stat long ol man i lus.

notes.subject: יכרת
notes.rationale: Hibru i usim tok bilong 'katim kontrak' long tok we i tok long kontrak (ברית) long v.4 — wanpela as, כרת.

translation: Bai mi givim long ol, insait long haus bilong mi na long ol banis bilong mi: han na nem, gutpela moa long ol pikinini man na ol pikinini meri; nem bilong oltaim bai mi givim long ⟨em⟩, we i no ken katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en.

tokens.gloss: na long ol banis bilong mi
ken katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
